question: _________ in Indian Dance is given in recognition of excellence and achievement in performance or research studies in Indian Dance.
solution:
The correct answer is __**The Manorama Thakkar Award.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Manorama Thakkar Award** is given in recognition of excellence and achievement in performance or research studies in Indian Dance.
 
• This prestigious award is a mark of honor for those who have made significant contributions to the field of Indian classical dance.
 
• It acknowledges the dedication, skill, and impact of the recipient in promoting and preserving the rich cultural heritage of Indian dance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian classical dance** includes various dance forms such as Bharatanatyam, Kathak, Odissi, Kuchipudi, Mohiniyattam, and others.
 
• These dance forms have a rich history and are deeply connected to Indian culture, mythology, and spirituality.
 
• Recognition through awards like the Nritya Choodamani helps in encouraging artists and researchers to continue their efforts in this field.
